terra.problem: The coffee joke mentions a food or drink outside the permitted exceptions.
“Nobody carries anything off” asserts more than the verse says. Jesus does not mention anyone carrying the pearls away.
“The Father in heaven gives far more” changes the comparison. Jesus says how much more the Father will give good things to those who ask Him, not that He gives a greater quantity.
The bear comparison does not explain the guess, and the claim that wolves could slip into a flock makes the joke confusing.
The oven line does not make a clear comparison with Jesus’ statement and does not land as a joke.
“The difference between good fruit and none” turns not bearing good fruit into bearing no fruit. Jesus also speaks of trees bearing bad fruit.
The oven joke is unclear: standing at an oven does not explain why the cookies would not bake.
